ai.title: Remove logger test file
ai.summary: Deleted backend/src/util/__tests__/logger.test.ts. The file contained 181 lines of tests for splitData covering primitives, objects, arrays, and nested structures. Removal indicates the tests were deemed unnecessary or redundant.

eli5.text: The company deleted a file of automated safety checks that were making sure large messages get broken into smaller pieces correctly when sent. Only people working on the software's internal code would notice anything, and only if they were looking directly at the test files. These checks covered everyday cases like splitting long text messages and large data structures, and they've been marked as no longer needed. Nothing you do with the software changes because of this.

ai.title: Send tool call id in background process tool result
ai.summary: Background process updates now return an array of ToolResult objects with the original tool call id instead of a single aggregated result with a generated compact id. `BackgroundProcessInfo` splits `id` into `pid` and `toolCallId`, and `getBackgroundProcessUpdates` maps each process to its own `ToolResult`. `runTerminalCommand` and `runBackgroundCommand` in `npm-app/src/utils/terminal.ts` and `npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts` thread the tool call id through to the process manager. `npm-app/src/client.ts` spreads the array into `toolResults` rather than conditionally concatenating.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant to run a background task, you now get a separate, clearly-labeled result for that specific task alongside any other output, rather than a single combined message that mixed everything together. This makes it easier to tell which output belongs to which background task you started. The change is live today for internal use.
